notes.title: New Feature Spotlight - Jumping Mushroom - Coming in the Big Update
notes.content: [p]Hello Abyss Explorers,[/p][p]We know your journey through the Abyss can be… quite a climb. That’s why we’ve added something both fun and practical:[/p][p][/p][p]🍄 Jumping Mushroom - a strange mushroom with a swirling crest on its cap. Step on it, and woosh! It will launch you sky-high in a blink.[/p][p][/p][p]We’ve also reworked the Abyss Hole. Now, instead of tedious backtracking, you can use Jumping Mushrooms to bounce your way upward. Faster, more convenient, and way more fun - a little boost goes a long way. 😉[/p][p][/p][p]Check out the video to see it in action![/p][p][/p][previewyoutube="H9vwaq2ZZ6w;full"][/previewyoutube]

notes.title: Dev Update – On the Road to the Big Update
notes.content: [p]Hello Abyss Explorers,[/p][p]Here’s a quick look at what we’ve been working on until the upcoming [b]Big Update[/b]:[/p][olist][*][p]Added Teleport feature. [/p][/*][*][p]Fixed most of the reported bugs listed in Bug-Report. [/p][/*][*][p]Improved Bow mechanics for smoother aiming and shooting. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked the Dreadjaw summoning altar and added new lore after you defeat him. [/p][/*][*][p]Titanholm progress: 30%. [/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned the Abyss Hole to be more intuitive. [/p][/*][*][p]Reworked Primorath.[/p][/*][*][p]Main Quest (new system) progress: 70%. [/p][/*][*][p]New feature in development: Villagers will no longer be available by default. You will have to search for them in the Abyss or rescue them from Goblin camps. (We’ll share full details once this system is complete.) [/p][/*][*][p]Each world will have more events to discover, left for you – the brave Abyss adventurers – to uncover. [/p][/*][/olist][p]🙏 Apology: We sincerely apologize for the delay in smaller patches. We wanted to combine everything into the upcoming Big Update, planned for release at the end of October.[/p]

notes.title: Update patch v0.1.6.5
notes.content:
Hello Abyss's Explorers, I just uploaded version v0.1.6.5 with several balance changes and fixes:
Increased the number of treasures found in chests while reducing item drops from enemies.
Fixed the Cooking achievement chain.
Fixed an issue where plants and grass could sometimes disappear when returning from Primorath to Eldergrove.
Various minor bug fixes.

Please download the latest version and enjoy the game.
Thank you all!

notes.title: 🔥Update v0.1.6 – Getting Ready for the BIG UPDATE!
notes.content: [h3]Bug Fixes[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed Storage Chest losing items when opened by Client first.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dying when returning to Eldergrove from Primorath.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed watering can losing water after refill.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed Cooking, Farming, and Crafting achievements not working.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed sleeping bag not disappearing after waking up.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed dino riding & interaction after taming.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed items falling through the ground & world duplication bug.[/p][/*][*][p]Disabled player damage to Pets.[/p][/*][*][p]Many other minor fixes.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Added[/h3][list][*][p]Difficulty selection when creating a new World.[/p][/*][*][p]Ability to [b]rename Storage Chests[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Online Co-op via Steam[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Durability for [b]Fishing Rod[/b] & [b]Bow[/b].[/p][/*][/list][h3]Adjustments[/h3][list][*][p]Village upgrade costs rebalanced.[/p][/*][*][p]Starter Quest now tied to part of Main Quest.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted completion condition for [i]Through the First Night[/i].[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][h3]Coming Soon – BIG UPDATE[/h3][list][*][p][b]Full Main Quest system[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Treasures[/b] to collect or sell for high value.[/p][/*][*][p]World 2 release may be delayed to prioritize Main Quest.[/p][/*][*][p]More gameplay improvements are planned.[/p][/*][/list][hr][/hr][p]⚠️ [b]Important:[/b] You will need to [b]create a new World[/b] to be compatible with the new quest system. Sorry for the inconvenience.[/p][p]Update now and enjoy the adventure![/p]

notes.title: Update v0.1.5 – Improved Experience & New Features
notes.content: [p][b]Bug Fixes:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Rune Collection achievement did not work when obtaining Runes from chests.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed the Abyssal Scroll Collection achievement not working.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where background music was sometimes too quiet.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where the Storage Chest could not be destroyed with a Hammer. (Items inside the Chest will remain, so you don’t need to empty it before breaking the Chest. Convenient, right? :D)[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Additions:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added item usage instructions when selecting them in the Hotbar.[/p][/*][*][p]Added an Unstuck button when you get stuck in an immovable position. (Available in the Pause Menu.)[/p][/*][*][p]Added achievements for defeating Goblins and Slimes to unlock higher weapon tiers and character stats, replacing the old Hunter achievement group.[/p][/*][*][p]Added guiding effects for the cave entrance leading to Primorath to make it easier to identify.[/p][/*][*][p]When you die, some of your Items will drop. You can return to pick them up, but be careful.[/p][/*][*][p]Added a new journal fragment: [i]Call of Destiny – Primorath[/i].[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Adjustments:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Enemies will no longer spawn if you are standing near a campfire within a 4-meter (~4 steps) range.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies will not spawn inside the Village. However, if they spawned before you entered the Village, they will remain and continue to chase you anywhere.[/p][/*][*][p]Higher-level Goblins will now drop higher-tier items upon defeat, but their strength has also been increased.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted gamepad hotkeys for smoother interaction.[/p][/*][*][p]HP will now automatically regenerate when Food is above 50% and will continue until Food drops below your HP value.[/p][/*][*][p]Your HP will now fully recover (100%) after sleeping.[/p][/*][*][p]Rebalanced the daily quest system.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted loot chests to contain more valuable rewards depending on their level.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the notes in the Diary Note [i]"Last Words of the Nameless Wanderer"[/i] item so that you can better visualize the next path.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted Eldergrove Village upgrade materials: now only Abyss Coins are required for upgrades.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the starting quest to be less lengthy. The starting point will now be located next to Eldergrove Village.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Upcoming Updates:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Add the Main Quest system.[/p][/*][*][p]Add NPC and Village interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]Complete the Mini Map for Primorath – World Layer 1.[/p][/*][*][p]Add weekly/monthly Eldergrove Events with enemies, difficulty, and corresponding rewards.[/p][/*][*][p]Add Armor stats.[/p][/*][*][p]World Layer 2 – Titanholm progress: 5%.[/p][/*][/list][p]👉 Please update to the latest version to experience these changes. If you encounter any issues, don’t forget to join our [url="https://discord.gg/CXt9xbvKNc"]Discord[/url] server and report bugs there. We’ll do our best to fix them as soon as possible. Thank you for playing![/p]

notes.title: 🌌 Abyss New Dawn – Early Access Release! 🎉
notes.content:
[p]Hello Explorers,[/p][p]The wait is over – [b]Abyss New Dawn is finally released in Early Access on Steam![/b] It’s been a long journey of farming, fighting, bug-fixing (and a lot of late-night coffee ☕), but we made it here together.[/p][p]Now it’s your turn to dive into the Abyss:
🐷 [b]Farm[/b] – raise crops, animals, and live cozy moments.
⚔️ [b]Fight[/b] – face goblins, bosses, and survive the unknown.

We can’t wait to see your screenshots, stories, and chaos in the Abyss.[/p][p]👉 Grab the game here: [url="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2747280/Abyss_New_Dawn/"]Abyss: New Dawn[/url][/p][p]See you in the Abyss! 💙[/p]

notes.title: When Bugs Become Comedy 🎭
notes.content:
[p][b]Hello Abyss’s Explorers,[/b][/p][p]🐷✨ During testing, we ran into a rather hilarious bug in [i]Abyss New Dawn[/i].
Instead of sitting upright while riding the pig, the character just lies flat on its back.[/p][p]At first glance, it looked broken… but then again, it almost felt like a moment of peaceful relaxation.
Not sure if it’s a bug or a feature, but it definitely gave us a good laugh while developing. 😅[/p][p]Little moments like this remind us how fun and unpredictable game development can be.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820761/909f860b05c7adff68f6d57f3222557d87c0b8e0.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Abyss New Dawn Release May Be Delayed Few Days
notes.content: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p]We sincerely apologize for the unexpected delay regarding the release of Abyss New Dawn.[/p][p][/p][p]During Steam’s review process, our latest build was rejected due to a technical issue: three achievements were missing descriptions. We have already fixed this and resubmitted the build for approval.[/p][p][/p][p]Steam usually takes 3–5 business days for the review, so the release date may be delayed until August 25th PDT (August 26th, local time in Asia) at the latest.[/p][p][/p][p]We truly appreciate your patience and understanding, and we will update you as soon as we hear back from Steam.[/p]

notes.title: Dev Update #36: New Creatures Arrive in Eldergrove!
notes.content:
Greetings, Brave Explorers of the Abyss! Previously, we posted some updates in the 'Game Updates' section, but from now on, we will be posting all new information in the 'Announcements/News' section to better suit the Coming Soon phase. Thank you for following us, and please continue to support us!

Prepare to welcome four new adorable creatures to Eldergrove, the starting land of your grand journey: Rabbits, Chickens, Ducks, and Foxes!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820761/f850ac7b61e2816a83d06adbb795134d4d739f68.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820761/5a462c1f941067d56d0e09e976ff8220e354d560.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820761/bbaf5e064d39a93d87847a6d98501c183adf1606.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820761/8718a56d1beab6fdc4997e0473d686696e3dd99d.png[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44820761/09e9adb95f9241d8d0b4bf6915c55c4752a47ca6.png[/img]

With this update, Eldergrove now flourishes with 10 unique animal species and 10 different types of Slimes, each adding more life and wonder to your adventure. But this is just the beginning - more animals and fish will soon arrive, making this land even more vibrant and full of magic.
At the same time, we are hard at work perfecting the Achievement and Quest system, preparing for the Early Access launch between June and August.
Sharpen your blades, ready your wits, and prepare for adventure - the Abyss awaits!

notes.title: Ride a golem and enjoy being catapulted into the air!!!
notes.content:
[b]Hello explorers! Hope y'all are having a nice day![/b]

Let's ride a golem and enjoy being catapulted into the air 🪂🤣
The Golem can also help you fight all kinds of enemies across the Abyss. 
The fight feature will be updated in the future.
